KeyHistoricalTerritoriesAndCities: Makkah, Madinah, Sana'a, Ta'if, Najran, Oman, Hadramawt, Bahrain, Al-Ahsa

KeyScholarsAndHistoricalFigures: Mansa Musa, Askia Muhammad I (Askia the Great), Ahmad Baba al-Timbukti, Usman dan Fodio
PrimarySourcesAndModernHistoriography: Ibn Battuta (The Rihlah); Al-Sa'di (Tarikh al-Sudan); Ibn al-Mukhtar (Tarikh al-Fattash)
